_comment: PROPOSED coverage expansion for Irving and Shane to review. Nothing here is confirmed: the checker never answers 'Yes' for these towns and they are not in the map shading, schema or Google profile. To confirm a town, move it to src/service-area.json (single source of truth) after Shane names it. Evidence and the full table: vault _context/coverage-proposal-2026-10-10.md.

evidence.owner-map: Shane's hand-drawn boundary on a phone map, received 2026-05-28 (vault _context/harvest/2026-05-28-service-area-map.jpg). Hand-drawn: edges are approximate.
evidence.irving-2026-10-10: Irving: Shane serves all of the North Shore, the areas around Saugus/Melrose, and outer Boston areas toward the North Shore (regional guidance, not a boundary).
evidence.mapc-nstf: MAPC North Shore Task Force subregion members (https://www.mapc.org/resource-library/nstf-subregion/), used only as a public definition of 'North Shore'.

tiers.likely: Inside the owner's drawn boundary AND matches Irving's 2026-10-10 description. Strongest candidates; still needs Shane's yes.
tiers.inside-map: Inside the owner's drawn boundary but outside Irving's 2026-10-10 description (west / Merrimack Valley / inner Boston suburbs). Needs Shane's yes.
tiers.edge: The hand-drawn line runs through or right beside the town. Needs Shane's yes.
tiers.conflict: Public North Shore definition (and Irving's 'all of the North Shore') includes it, but it lies outside the owner's May boundary. Needs Shane's answer.
